$Comment: The game's own Scrap Glider, a goblin gadget, for players Honored with the Hallowed (Hallows_Eve_Hallowed). The Requires block locks it until then; a locked offer still shows on the shelf, so a player can see what to work towards. Named by the item's own keys, written in full (server.items.<Id>.name) so the stall shows the name and line the item shows in the bag.
